paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss of a reward model over various training steps. The x-axis represents the training step on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1400. The y-axis represents the training loss on a linear scale, ranging from 0.3 to 0.7. A single blue line with a solid style and no markers depicts the training loss; it starts at approximately 0.85 and decreases to around 0.35. Initially, the line sharply declines from 0 to around 200 on the x-axis, then fluctuates relatively steadily around 0.35 from around 600 to 1400 on the x-axis.
